annotation.bound_parties_text: The instrument imposes license requirements on exporters and reexporters of items on the Commerce Control List (the text addresses "the exporter" and applicants for licenses).
annotation.bound_parties_quote: a license is required to export and reexport items related to the design, development, production, or use of missiles.
annotation.dates_quote: Source: 61 FR 12786, Mar. 25, 1996, unless otherwise noted.
